name: Reiri Valencia Kuga
original_name: レイリ・バレンシア・久我
source: Cheerful and sociable girl, she is half-Japanese with a Sephardic American father and a Japanese mother. She came to study in Japan a few years ago and to practice being a bride. She has a strong view on Japanese women, which could be caused by the impact of her mother's death. A very hard working girl but used to be very lazy and hated housework. She is naturally optimistic.
